title: Aquarius — Something Big Is Coming
script_text: Brace yourself, Aquarius — a storm reshapes your airy horizons, stirring bold new ideas. Monday and Tuesday bring Mercury trine Uranus in your 1st House, sparking bold self‑expression, while Mars squares your 7th House, inflaming relationship tensions. Wednesday powers up as the Sun enters your 10th House, lifting career visibility, though Saturn’s opposition hints at hurdles. Thursday’s Venus sextile to Neptune in your 5th House sparks romance and creativity. Friday’s Jupiter trine to your 2nd House expands finances and optimism. Saturday’s Mercury conjunct Pluto in your 8th House deepens intimacy. Sunday’s lunar eclipse in your 4th House urges emotional release and home reassessment. Wednesday is your power day as the Sun enters your 10th House. Tuesday is your toughest day with Mars squaring your 7th House. Meditate Saturday morning to ground Pluto’s intensity and safeguard your energy. Follow for daily updates.
